images.prompt: Create a complete expanded ground-floor top-down RPG map, handmade expressive opaque dry gouache, angular organic imperfect shapes, broad visible brushstrokes, broken ink outlines, dusty violet shadows and muted ochre institutional candlelight. Reference 1 is the existing floor layout and painting style; reference 2 shows laundry furnishings. This is a NEW expanded master map, NOT an atlas. Landscape format, high detail but clear empty walking space, all rooms visible in this overview, orthographic overhead cutaway walls, no people, no text, no legend, no door animation strips. Preserve recognizable arrangement of original core: top left two-bed dormitory, top middle reading room with bookshelves and desks, TOP RIGHT REPLACE ALL PRISON BARS AND CELLS WITH A SINGLE SQUARE STORAGE ROOM of confiscated belongings, letters hats watches clothes toys suitcases and boxes, with clear central floor and doorway onto main corridor below. Main horizontal corridor connects these three rooms. Below corridor: large dining/obelisk hall on left, kitchen on right; below kitchen observation office and small abandoned Elias bedroom with one unmade bed, dusty desk and wardrobe IN PLACE OF OLD ARCHIVE ROOM. NO prison cells and NO archive room anywhere on this ground floor. Expand map to right beyond original core with an outdoor enclosed courtyard (stone paving, bare tree, two benches), connected via obvious unobstructed doorway from main corridor; laundry room beside courtyard with top-loading vertical washer, dirty clothes basket, sink, service cabinet, ledger desk. Courtyard to laundry doorway clearly visible. A service stair going DOWN next to kitchen is clearly distinguished from other doors; altar/obelisk hall has separate small concealed stair hatch beside altar to the basement archive route. Main entrance at far left corridor. Distinct connected rooms, thick cutaway wall separation, visible door gaps no disconnected rooms. Keep all furniture inside walls, clear circulation. Dark plum background outside building. Whole map fits frame with margins. Mood mysterious neglected institution, not cheerful. No UI, no painted labels.

Create a complete separate underground floor map for a top-down RPG, expanding the reference basement in exactly its handpainted dry opaque gouache and angular organic irregular ink style. Orthographic overhead cutaway walls, landscape image, no people, no text, no UI, no sprite atlas. Show ONE connected basement complex: service staircase descending at far left into long wide corridor; two distinct enclosed cells side by side along upper middle corridor, each with individual barred front door, narrow bed, thin blanket, empty food bowl, cold bleak neglected stone; these are Mira and Tomas cells. Far right archive room with shelves of documents, ledger table, clear central walking space. Archive access from corridor blocked by a heavy closed distinctive violet-symbol door; ordinary service stair NEVER bypasses this locked door. Inside archive, a SECOND separate stairwell on far right goes up to altar secret passage, clearly separated from service stair by cell wing and locked door. Composition must show both staircases, two cells, corridor and large archives as separate spaces with correct door connections. Sparse small candles, heavy charcoal/plum/violet shadows, muted ivory highlights, strong dry paint strokes, ominous sad oppressive atmosphere but paths, bars, doors and ledger stay readable. Floor outside rooms near black. Broad shapes, no photorealistic texture, no distressed border. Whole floor fits image.
